field_updates.detail: Fig. 5 - Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage (red; log 0.1-1000 mA vs linear 0-10 V; "tp/T = 0.001, tp = 10 us"). Read points: 1.00 mA @ 1.511 V (resid +3.4 mV); 2.00 mA @ 1.562 V (resid -4.8 mV); 5.00 mA @ 1.661 V (resid -1.4 mV); 10.00 mA @ 1.765 V (resid +3.5 mV); 20.00 mA @ 1.910 V (resid -0.1 mV); 30.00 mA @ 2.037 V (resid -0.7 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=1.910 V vs stated typ 2.00 V (-90 mV); "Forward voltage IF = 20 mA VF - 2 3 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector path itself (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from the drawn gridline coordinates; read points interpolated on the drawn centreline (log I). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 6 points 1.00-30.0 mA, rms 2.9 mV. Window sensitivity: windows 1-20/1-30/1-50/2-30/5-30 mA give N 2.35-3.16, RS 9.2-11.7 ohm; including 0.1-0.3 mA (curve drawn non-monotonic there) gives N 1.19. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
field_updates.scope: Vishay TLHR5200 red (+VLHW5100 white variant); IS for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit
